company.name: Cowboy Space
company.shortDescription: Cowboy Space builds a power grid and computing infrastructure designed for artificial intelligence workloads.
company.description: Cowboy Space is a space infrastructure company focused on developing systems for in-orbit computing, space-based power, and launch capabilities. The company is building Low Earth Orbit satellites designed to harness solar energy and support data processing applications in space. Its approach integrates launch vehicles and orbital data centers into a single system, with rocket upper stages intended to remain in orbit as operational computing platforms. Cowboy Space is also working on technologies related to transmitting energy from space to Earth and supporting high-performance computing beyond terrestrial infrastructure. The company’s team includes engineers and specialists with experience from aerospace, satellite, and technology organizations.
